image.tooltip: Foreground to despill (sRGB, or linear from the Advanced keyer).

screen.tooltip: Screen color whose spill is removed.

method.tooltip: Limit for the screen channel: average of the other two (CorridorKey default), max (gentlest) or min (strongest).

redistribute.tooltip: On (CorridorKey's method): the removed spill is split equally over the other two channels, so R+G+B stays the same; luminance does not (removing green spill still darkens). Off: the spill is just removed.

CorridorKey2Despill.name: CorridorKey2Despill
CorridorKey2Despill.description: Removes green/blue screen spill from a foreground. Instant to tweak: connect the keyer's foreground (with its own despill at 0) and adjust here without re-running the model.
